scientific_integrity: Explicit analytic proof and reproducible finite diagnostics supplied; finite tests are not substitutes for universal proof. The quoted status is a self-review, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharp quasi-triangle coefficient proved only for 0<p<=2/3 on the rank-one projector space, in Hilbert dimension at least two.
No coefficient is claimed for 2/3<p<1, for mixed states, or for nonpositive inputs.
Existing literature establishes qualitative failure of metricity outside its known range; that failure is not claimed as new.
Independent priority verification remains to be performed.
title: Sharp subunit \(p\)-Bures quasi-triangle constant for pure-state projections
